# repo-analysis

Git-repo structure, framework, and section-diff analysis (`@melodic/repo-analysis`: `parseGitHubUrl`, `detectRepoStructure`, `detectFrameworks`, `countFiles`, `diffSections`, `diffStartEnd`) and the shallow clone (`@melodic/repo-analysis/clone`: `shallowCloneGitHubRepo`, `liveCloneGroupCount`), hardened for an untrusted repository by default (https as the only transport, symbolic links checked out as plain files); `inheritGitEnvironment: true` runs git with the user's own config and credentials instead, for a repository the user is entitled to. It has no command-line entry: `/absorb-upstream` reads a repository through the GitHub API and clones nothing. Pure Node builtins, node:test. Consumed via `file:` package dependency. Tests use `node:test` because the package declares no test-framework dependency; `skills/course-digest/extraction` keeps vitest.

Owner: shared capability with no single skill owner; `/course-digest` (`analyze-code-repo.js`) and `/video-digest` (`analyze-harvested-repos.js`) jointly consume, so changing it means exercising every consumer. Consumers derive on demand via the repo dep-graph edge scan (`tools/AGENTS.md` "Vertical slices").
